test.summary: SPM - OKR - Updating Multi-Select custom field values across OKR views
test.description:
This test verifies updating Multi-Select custom field values across all supported OKR views.

Covered areas:

* OKR Detail page
* Overview (inline editing)
* Side panel

Validation scope:

* Editing and saving Multi-Select custom field values
* Selecting multiple available dropdown values
* Removing selected values
* Verifying selected values are displayed correctly across all supported views
* Correct dropdown and inline editing behavior across supported views

steps.action:
*Preconditions:*

* Multi-select custom field is created and assigned to Strategic Theme, Objective and Key Result (used-in)
* Existing OKRs contain predefined values for fields
* User has permissions to edit OKRs and custom field values

rag.text:
Test: TC-6164 — SPM - OKR - Updating Multi-Select custom field values across OKR views
Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/SPM/OKR/TS-512 OKR - OKR module
Labels: spm-mikolaj-tc

Description:
This test verifies updating Multi-Select custom field values across all supported OKR views.

Covered areas:

* OKR Detail page
* Overview (inline editing)
* Side panel

Validation scope:

* Editing and saving Multi-Select custom field values
* Selecting multiple available dropdown values
* Removing selected values
* Verifying selected values are displayed correctly across all supported views
* Correct dropdown and inline editing behavior across supported views

Steps:
1. *Preconditions:*

* Multi-select custom field is created and assigned to Strategic Theme, Objective and Key Result (used-in)
* Existing OKRs contain predefined values for fields
* User has permissions to edit OKRs and custom field values
   Expected: 
2. Open OKR Overview of boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-6164 SPM - OKR - Updating Multi-select custom field values across OKR views
   Expected: Overview module is opened. The following OKRs are visible:

* Strategic theme 1
* Objective 1
* Key result 1
3. Navigate to Multi-select field
   Expected: Multi-select field is visible for Strategic Theme, Objective and Key Result.

The following text field values are displayed correctly for each item:

* Strategic Theme - "Frontend"
* Objective - "Frontend", "Backend"
* Key Result - "Frontend", "Backend", "QA"
4. Navigate to the Strategic theme Multi-select custom field and click on field value
   Expected: Dropdown with available select custom field values is displayed correctly:

* Frontend
* Backend
* QA

Clear button is displayed for individual selected values and for the entire Multi-Select custom field

!xray-attachment://272abffd-d609-40a5-9092-5b13ba109761|width=438,height=334!
5. Click clear for individual selected value (frontend)
   Expected: Selected value is removed  and dropdown remains available for selecting new values


!xray-attachment://dcbb3924-e079-4b18-b64d-438b4a7115e8|width=509,height=348!
6. Click outside the field
   Expected: Dropdown is closed and the custom field remains empty after clicking outside the field
7. Navigate to the Key result Select custom field → click Clear button for entire field and change the value
   Data: newValue: Backend
   Expected: The new field value is saved and displayed correctly
8. Click on the grey area of the Key result row
   Expected: Side panel is opened on the right side and displays details of the selected Key result. Multi-select field is visible with correct value.
9. Navigate to the Key result Multi-select custom field and add the value
   Data: newValue: QA
   Expected: The new field value is saved and displayed correctly

Backend, QA
10. Open Key result in the detail page and navigate to the Info section
   Expected: Detail page is opened. Multi-select field is visible with correct value.
11. Navigate to the Key result Select custom field → click Clear button for entire field and change the value
   Data: newValue: Frontend, QA
   Expected: The new field value is saved and displayed correctly
